name: Plan Runner
desc: Hand a build plan to an agent on the build server; it builds, tests, commits and pushes.
about: Agents send a plan for a git repository over MCP. One job at a time, an agent (Claude Code here; a separate work instance uses Codex) carries it out in a fresh clone, building and testing as it goes and committing per phase, then the runner pushes. The page shows each job's plan, commits and live log.

intents.phrase: …have an agent carry out a build plan
intents.desc: Send a plan for a repository; it's built, tested, committed and pushed while you do something else.
